summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload math_init.js
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript file (string-array-shuffle obfuscation via a rotating constant array, hex-identifier variable names, custom character-decode routine) executed by the freshly-dropped Bun interpreter at install time. The advertised purpose is a CircleCI orb (src/ contains only CircleCI orb YAML for commands/executors/jobs), and package.json's declared main=index.js is absent from the tarball; neither the Bun runtime nor the obfuscated blob is relevant to that purpose. The alternate-runtime drop is used to execute code under an interpreter Node-based scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
